The **Attention** group of the node palette has 6 nodes: all run.

| Node | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Cross Attention](../attention/cross-attention.md) | Runs | Trainable attention of one sequence (Query) over another (Key / Value) |
| [Linear Attention](../attention/linear-attention.md) | Runs | Trainable self-attention whose cost grows linearly with sequence length. |
| [Multi-Head Attention](../attention/multi-head-attention.md) | Runs | Trainable self-attention over a sequence tensor. |
| [Positional Encoding](../attention/positional-encoding.md) | Runs | Sinusoidal or learned encoding for sequence positions. |
| [Transformer Decoder](../attention/transformer-decoder.md) | Runs | One decoder-only causal transformer block containing masked self-attention and an internal Dense/FC feed-forward path. |
| [Transformer Encoder](../attention/transformer-encoder.md) | Runs | One trainable transformer encoder block for sequence tensors. |
